name: BTILC 40th Anniversary Gerald Okamura Figure
description:
It's been 40 years since Big Trouble in Little China hot the Screens. Let's celebrate with this awesome mini fig of Gerald Okamura wielding his in his dual golden six shooters. Each figure is hand poured hard resin and stands at just about 3 inches tall. He comes bagged and carded with art by the one and only @wtedesign.

I do my best to avoid defects, but they are hand made. They are hard resin, so if you drop them from high enough, he may lose a gun barrel (I stupidly chucked one at the ground to test this out).

Anywhoo... I don't have many, so if you want one and don't get one, I'll make some more asap - my mold went to shit so I have to make a new one. They are really great in hand and a really fun take on the Legendary Gerald Okamura.

name: Keshi Cheese Goblin
description:
Goblins? Goblins you say??? This ain't no ordinary Goblin. This is the second cousin of the Cheddar Goblin that you may have seen in Mandy. Or, you may have seen this dude in a McDonald's happy meal... Anyway... 

HERE HE IS - THE AMERICAN CHEESE GOBLIN!!! He is made from semi-rigid urethane (task-16. He stands on his own and has some flex but no jiggle.  Just how you like it. Chonky af and he knows it. 

Each comes bagged with a gorgeous gigantic header card. 

He is a lovingly hand cast bootleg by yours truly. All art done by the amazing @wtedesign.

name: Return of the Kung Fu Claw!
description:
I am super excited and proud to bring back this killer collab between @officialgeraldokamura (hand model), @nopal62 (original artwork) @worst_toy_ever_design (packaging) @simian_cheese (print/mold/cast/packaging) and NoGoodName(3D sculptor).

THE KUNG FU CLAW stands just under 3 inches and is made of keshi-like rubber. They are hand cast by the Cheese Master in marbled day-glo uv colors and some gid stuff.

Each comes on a blister card designed by the one and only @worst_toy_ever_design.

description:
What would happen if E.T. and He-Man had a baby? Probably not this, but it's not likely to happen anyway. 

You will get one Faker Blue HE.-T. that will blow your mind. If you can't handle having your mind blown, please don't buy one. I think some of these may even glow with the Power. 

All are bagged and come with an insanely cool diorama - Basically, you unfold and flip the header card and voila' HE.-T. is now way more playable. He's a great desk idol or stocking stuffer. Go nuts.

name: Random Metal(lic) HE.-T.
description:
What would happen if E.T. and He-Man had a baby? Probably not this, but it's not likely to happen anyway. 

You will get one random Mettalic HE.-T. that will blow your mind. If you can't handle having your mind blown, please don't buy one. I think some of these may even glow with the Power. 

These aren't painted, it's a metallic powder that goes into the mold and becomes one with the figure. It's super reflective, hypnotically pleasing and a treat to your senses.

name: Pazuzu In MY Pocket - Random Color
description:
Is that a Pazuzu In Your Pocket, or are you just happy to see me? Ha... ha.. ha.. yeah...
This is a bootleg of a toob toy that you can get on amazon for pennies, but they're grey and kinda suck. These are way better and why they cost a million times more. Each one is hand poured, pigmented, etc. Some are metallic, some are clear, some glow, some are just cool in general. Each comes bagged and carded. You can mention what you like in the order comments and I will do my best to accomodate.

Awesome card art by @wtedesign

name: The Man of Many Weapons
description:
Simian Cheese is proud to bring you The Man of Many Weapons! For almost 70 years, Gerald Okamura has been kicking ass. He has spent his life creating and mastering weaponry of every kind imaginable. With 39 feature films under his belt and still crushing heads today he is truly LEGEND.

This amazing homage to Gerald is beautifully sculpted by @therojotoy and cast by myself. He comes with six interchangeable arms which each carry a unique death machine. The man himself is cast in semi-rigid urethane rubber (task-16) and the arms as cast in rigid resin (325). The arms plug into four holes in the Masters back and reach around to kick-ass. It is a bit of a balancing act to get him to stand with the assortment of arms, but it's kinda fun.

The amazing card art by @worsttoyeverdesign doubles as a weapons rack to hold the unused weaponry.

The Man stands at 2 inches tall.

name: I am Nugget hat. Make a statement.
description:
Make a statement by wearing this hat. What that statement is.... Hmmm.... maybe you are an adult film star? Maybe you wanna proudly represent the mustache crowd. Maybe you are just fried? I dunno... You know people are going to ask, so have something ready.... just sayin'

These are awesome. All made by local talent in my town. They are super high quality hats with kick-ass professional embroidery on them.

This ship in boxes so that they won't get smushed.

**** International folks, shoot me a DM @simian_cheese on IM and we can figure out shipping. **** 

Each comes with a holographic sticker of authenticity to ensure that it is authentic, which it is. Sticker designed by @wtedesign

District ® Super Soft Mesh Back Cap
Fabric: 100% cotton twill front panels, 100% polyester mesh mid and back panels
Structure: Unstructured
Profile: Low
Closure: 7-position adjustable snap

name: Simian Cheese's Paint by Nuggets: Hopalong Nuggity
description:
Why did I do this? Hmmmm that's a very good question... I thought it was a good idea... is that enough? haha I've always liked paint by numbers by always hated the content. Kittens, puppies, landscapes... I'm not hating on kittens, puppies nor landscapes, I just don't want to paint them. 

So to make a long story longer, I made these. 

They're totally hand made and I have never done anything like this before. The 'canvas' is a museum quality 100% acid-free 246lb paper. Wha huh? That means that it is really good quality and cost me a pretty penny. I mixed the paint colors (15 of them) as best as I could, if they're not good enough, please mix your own - switch color palettes, flock it, add some neon, do what you do. 

They come with a little brush and a bigger brush. They should be good enough. If not, you know the drill....

1 of 9.25 inch X 12 inch premium art board
1 color printout of how good it could be
1 very legible color key thing so that you can read all of the teeny numbers
1 kind small brush
1 slightly larger brush
15 pots of paint that kinda match the palette see in the printout
1 pot of pearly shite paint, go nuts
1 pot of black pain. Just because.

**** International folks, shoot me a DM @simian_cheese on IM and we can figure out shipping. **** 

I also did a Frankenstein one but am not going to fill any more paint pots any time soon. If you're interested, let me know on IG @simian_cheese

name: A couple of Random HE.-T.
description:
What would happen if E.T. and He-Man had a baby? Probably not this, but it's not likely to happen anyway. 

These are a couple of random ones - one is black and the other a clear blue.

All are bagged and come with an insanely cool diorama - Basically, you unfold and flip the header card and voila' HE.-T. is now way more playable. He's a great desk idol or stocking stuffer. Go nuts.

name: ECTO STICKERS
description: Worst Toy Ever Designs and Simian Cheese are proud to bring you ECTO STICKERS. 8 kiss cut vinyl stickers packed into one ecto containment unit. These stickers are YOUR proof of a ghostly encounter!!!

name: WTESC - Mighty Max Head Sticker Sheet
description:
Well, these are cool. 9 little Mighty Max Horror Heads stylized and lovingly placed on a sticker sheet by @wtedesign. One is missing his ears... no one is perfect. You should get these and stick them all over the place, they will make you happy. 

Sticker design by the one and only Worst Toy Ever Design @wtedesign

name: The Boy in the Plastic Clamshell
description:
This is a purely selfish project. I used to watch this movie with my mom when I was a wee little one. Such a strange movie and one of Johnny Travolta's first. This Sweathog has been meticulously hand booted and hand painted (non-flesh version) by the Cheese Master himself. He comes in a plastic clamshell to protect him from the evils of the outside world. 

The graphics were once again designed by the amazing @worst_toy_ever_design

name: Okamura Punch - The drink with a kick!
description:
Made of super elastic and spastic rubber that stretches, bends, smooshes and can take a beating - just like The Legend himself Gerald Okamura. 

They don't stand well, they're meant to be smooshed. Some of them, you can kinda suction them onto a flat surface, but not all. This is another tough material to work with - just sayin'

Various colors available, use the pulldown thing and look at pic. They are all awesome.

options.name: D - UV Orange (nothing rhymes with orange)
E - Weird Glow in the Dark Green

name: Simian Cheese's GOLDENBALLS - Foamy Sophia
description:
She so foamy.
Made in the likeness of the greatest Golden Girl of them all, Sophia. She's sassy, she's snarky, she's cynical as hell - and now, she's FOAMY! Yes... she's made from slow rise foam!! 

There's one that I refer to as a 'paint test' - it's cheaper. It's an early prototype that I tried a different paint treatment on the eyes.

I also have some imperfect blanks for cheap. These have bubbles, gaps, voids inside and are not painted. If you just want something to be weird with, this is your cheap option to do so.

All hand made and hand painted with graphics by the almighty @worsttoyeverdesigns.

name: The Legend Punch Dispenser
description:
Each is a fully functional punch dispenser made in the likeness of The Legend himself @officialgeraldokamura. I carved the crap out of a solid resin head by @mondaytoyclub, gutted a pez for it's functional innards, married the two with apoxy, molded, cast, painted, assembled, whew! Then sculpted a little fist that fits inside the punch dispenser, molded, cast in fabulous colors (some bloody flesh, some glow). Each will come with six or so of fists and three packs of delicious pez candy. Don't eat the fists unless you like broken teeth. Then blisters... Cleaning blisters, printing and cutting stickers, cutting thick ass board, sticking stickers to said board, punching board and then finally taping the blister down and..... done! Easy peasy lemon squeezey.

**** For the first time, I am offering up my prototype/master on this one. It's the actual one that I carved up, combined with Pez parts and then made my mold from. He'll come carded as well, but he's special because he's one of one. Oh, and he'll come with my original 'sculpt' for the fist - that's one of one too ;) ***

Once again thanks to @wtedesign for the awesome card art, I can't do it without him.

name: Simian Cheese's Nugget Buddies
description:
Have you ever wanted to snuggle with your McNuggets and just found it not so satisfying? Don't worry, you aren't weird, you aren't alone. Well, maybe you are all of that, but anyway... The little Nugget Buddies need homes. They are doing the best that they can, but they need love and lots of it. They are super easy to take care of, but the basic cute furry monster rules apply: 1) Don't get wet 2) Don't expose to bright lights 3) Don't feed after midnight. They aren't much trouble unless you break any one of those rules... then you're f*cked. 

These are all very hand made by very talented people in my town. No factories, no sweatshops, no child labor. Actually, I did put my kids to work on these, so there.

They are roughly twice the size of a McNugget. They are made of super soft, super elegant furry goodness and stuffed with super luxurious, silky stuffing. 

Each is very hand made and no two will ever be alike. You can push the bottoms in (oh baby) and make them stand, which is awesome.

You should really adopt two, maybe they're unrelated, will fall in love any make baby Nugget buddies - wouldn't that be something? Let's just hope that they are truly unrelated... which is unlikely.

**** International folks, shoot me a DM @simian_cheese on IM and we can figure out shipping. **** 

The packaging is designed by my counterpart in crime @wtedesign

name: Simian Cheese's Monster Mess
description:
This is a collection of a few of my favorite weirdos. They are all different colors, most light up under UV or glow in the dark of night. Some don't. You won't know until you open them at a disco or in your closet.

Each blind bag (just keep reading) will have AT LEAST 4 of the 6 different figures. They're all bootlegs, a couple have been shrunk like crazy, if they're clear and colorless, they likely glow. They're all super fun and will make great desk haunts. 

As always, kick-ass monster header card by the one and only Worst Toy Ever Design @wtedesign

THE SPINNING WILL HAPPEN LIVE on IG (@simian_cheese) ON WEDS AUG 3 at 8:30PM Eastern time. See you then!! Woohoo!  https://www.instagram.com/simian_cheese/

$8 gets you one spin. One spin guarantees you one Simian T head.  The machine is full of a random assortment of keshi and hard rubber Ts. Some glow, some change color in the sun, some change color in heat, some are clear, some are not, some bounce others clank, some light up under black light, some do nothing. 

SOMEONE WILL GET THE GOLDEN T!!! Whoever this is will win a random pile of Simian goods. I am not sure what it is yet, but you won't be disappointed. And if you are, you can try to sell them on eBay where you will be disappointed.

description:
THE SPINNING WILL HAPPEN LIVE on IG (@simian_cheese) ON WEDS AUG 3 at 8:30PM Eastern time. See you then!! Woohoo!  https://www.instagram.com/simian_cheese/

One spin guarantees you  one of the following:

name: The Scumbag
description:
Why is he a Scumbag? I dunno.. he just looks kinda gnarly. I am sure he has a better rep in the universe where he originated, but here, he's a scumbag. They all various flavors of scum. The top half of the pic is daylight, the bottom under UV. A few also GID. Pick a number and pick a scumbag! He's hard resin and hand cast.

As always, kick-ass Scumbag header card by the one and only Worst Toy Ever Design @wtedesign

name: Return of the Crypt Creeper's Return
description:
A few people hit me up to make a few more of these, so here they are.  These are likely the last ones. 

-------------------------------

You asked, so he's back. The Crypt Creeper returns. He's a 100% bootleg freak from the board game, but I have made him better. That's the whole point of bootlegging right? Anyway... Most of these little dudes are double pour (meaning that they have basically been cast twice - two resin batches, twice in the pressure pot). Their fleshless faces glow like the sun (green/blue more than red/orange) in the dark and some even glow more under UV. No two are the same, just like me and you. 

The header card is super flip-overable and magically transform into a playset. Not Transformers, stop it - it's a playset. Yes, a playset (designed by @worsttoyeverdesign)! Made of 100% cardstock and ink!! This playset will allow you to get deeply into immersive play with your Creep, you will spend days marching him around from one side of the card to the next, spinning tales of horror and dread. But wait.... there's more! Each comes with an accurate to scale tombstone! Or, is it a gravestone? Anyway... Each comes with a little grave marker that may glow or not, may light up under uv or not, it may do nothing at all but mark an imaginary grave - that's ok. It has a little space on it for you to write a loved one's name or maybe someone you'd like to see dead. This is your place to be you - so, be you.

Each Creep comes bagged and tagged like any good corpse. And, they all have thumbs.

name: Rata de Arbol Satanica (Satanic Tree Rat)
description:
This Fall, a simple minded squirrel plunged his stupid little hands deep into the Earth, looking for a place to stash his acorn. Unbeknownst to him, he was digging into a vortex of space, time and faith. His grubby little nails levered into a crack that was the only seal between this world and the one below. Primordial ooze flowed, demons spewed from the strata like mint mentos in a warm bottle of coke. The poor little bugger (yes, now I feel sorry for him) struggled to hang on to his acorn and the very fabric of reality as Beelzebub himself emerged from the inter-dimensional  fracture. Having suffered millennia of thirst, the lord of darkness embraced our little furry protagonist as a herald sent forth to welcome the king. Within seconds they were one. Flesh, fur and pure visceral evil became one. This is the story of La Rata de Arbol Satanica... Take heed, keep your eyes open and one on the ground for He is now everywhere....

Ok, not really. I just found this really weird squirrel head laying around and fell in love with it. I knew it could be better, so here it is. Squirrels are weird as are most furry things that run around in the grass and eat nuts (myself included).

I threw in an option to have him mounted on a plaque - or, you can get one at Michael's and glue it on yourself.

I hope that you enjoy these.  They are life size. They are all hand cast in hard resin. Most have glow in the dark eyes. Some glow all over. Some don't glow at all. Some are mounted. Some are two headed. I made the graphics myself, that's why it looks like I made it myself.

That is all. Enjoy the show.

name: Vinny Barbarainbow
description: Does this really need a description? LOL. I just don't even know....  Each Vinny stands at 3 inches tall and is cast in translucent resin (325). The card back features a twisted game of Operation... This is my first real attempt at doing the card art by myself. I tried... hahaha

name: BerniE.T. Part II: Beyond the Pale
description: Poor BerniET. People have been asking for more BerniETs and of course we had to put him in mittens on the card. Thanks once again to @worsttoyeverdesign for the card art.

name: Mork & Monkey
description:
Again, I just don't know. This started as a paint-a-figure kit that I picked up at a flea market. When I sat down to mold it, the Mindy sculpt was so bad that she looked like a monkey... and this was born. The original Mindy head has been removed and replaced with a 3d printed head that I sculpted hair on. This was literally one of the funnest project I have ever worked on.

The card art... I mean... just... My partner in crime @worsttoyecverdesign is a genius. I can bring him a stupid idea like this and bam! A masterpiece.

Each Mork and Monkey is hand cast in opaque Ork red and stand at just about 4 inches tall - though I doubt you'll want to open this one. The card back is just amazing as the front.

name: Johnny De-Kai : Raw Meat Edition
description:
Brought to you by @therojotoy, @simian_cheese and @WorstToyEverDesign.

Johhny De-Kai (get it... decay) and comes in just under 3 inches tall and is cast in hard resin to hold in all of his meaty goodness. He can take a blow if you don't mind getting raw meaty stuff all over you. He is currently ranked #1... or just picked up a medal somewhere.

Each Johnny De-Kai comes bagged with an awesome kung fu tournament backdrop header card. 

Snatch him up before he's gone!

name: Johnny De-Kai One-Offs
description:
Brought to you by @therojotoy, @simian_cheese and @WorstToyEverDesign.

Johhny De-Kai (get it... decay) and comes in just under 3 inches tall and is cast in hard resin to hold in all of his meaty goodness. He can take a blow if you don't mind getting raw meaty stuff all over you. He is currently ranked #1... or just picked up a medal somewhere.

These are each a unique color, no two are alike. You will own one of one. How cool is that? Only you. 

Each Johnny De-Kai comes bagged with an awesome kung fu tournament backdrop header card. 

Snatch him up before he's gone!

options.name: E - Clear UV GID Blue Johnny

name: Wasteland Punx
description:
Don't mess with the Wasteland Punx! This Fink Angel has been recast in UV red/orange hard resin and is ready for action. He wields a cleaver/mace combo that will leave you wanting more pain. 

Each has been hand cast by the Cheese Master and the simply awesome card art by the amazing @worst_toy_ever_designs

name: The Accomplice Hand - The Bad One 4 & 5
description:
Each one of these murderous little bastards is cast in durable urethane rubber (task-16). He's been under pressure in the interrogation pot three times. Once to explain the red nose, again to explain the blood and then finally the glove... I mean who wears a glove all of the time?? 

Each comes bagged with an amazing header card designed by @wtedesign.

name: Hypno Ghoul Head - by Mr. Evil and Simian & Sons  - EINP
description:
The Hypno Ghoul Head, a killer collab between the one and only Mr. Evil and Simian & Sons. Each is hand crafted and cast in hard resin with metallic powders cast right in. These are not painted. 

Each comes in a hand made box with a unique gallows pole for the ghoul to sit upon.

They come in a variety of colors, I hope you find one that you like. 

This was inked by @jasonevilcovelli, sculpted by my kid and printed/molded/cast by me - a true collaboration.

name: The Accomplice Hand - The Bad One 6 & 7
description:
Each one of these murderous little bastards is cast in durable urethane rubber (task-16). He's been under pressure in the interrogation pot three times. Once to explain the red nose, again to explain the blood and then finally the glove... I mean who wears a glove all of the time?? 

Each comes bagged with an amazing header card designed by @wtedesign.

name: Weird Wendys
description:
None of these have bones.... Just sacks of strangeness. Each one unique...

One is dark and dreary until the lights go out. One has been though hell. The other just glows like a mofo.

Each comes bagged with an amazing header card designed by @wtedesign. I can only post 5 pics per item... so I can't show it off here... boo!

description:
Worst Toy Ever Design and Simian Cheese are proud to bring you the Inter-Dimensional Beast! Brought through a worm-hole from 1997 Wendy's and Deter's Lab, straight into the Simian Expander machine and finally into the Inter-Dimensional Beast Containment Unit. 

This sucker is a giant at just over three inches tall! He glows at night and will eat your children's faces during the day. The Containment Unit was designed by Worst Toy Ever Design and should only be opened by the rightful adopted parent (adoption certificate included). 

Simian nor Toy are responsible for any mayhem or destruction brought about by your Beast. It's on you. All you. Don't blame us. You have been warned. Open at your own risk.

This is an EDC figure, one for your pocket to remind to play a little. Maybe not play in your pocket... take him out first... because you never know what people will think.

Pic #2 is in the dark(ish)

He is lovingly hand cast in hard resin with shiny metallic green/red/gold flakes which makes him appear meteoric and heroic at the same time.

name: Ram-Blo
description:
NAME: Yo Ram-blo
NATIONALITY: AMERICANO
AGE: UNKNOWN/CLASSIFIED/NOT RATED/UNRATED/XXX-RATED
HEIGHT: ~4 INCHES
MATERIAL: HARD RESIN
COLOR: RANDOM GUMBALL COLORS

HOBBIES AND OCCUPATIONS: Green Beret, Pink Beret, Special Services, Special OPs, Secret Service, NAVY SEAL, Commie Annihilator, Shriners Club, 4H Club, Quilting Club, Cat Lady, Potential Bubblegum Assassinator.

WEAPONS: Sexy Knife Blade, Ram-Bow and Arrow, Dip Spit, Vanity Mirror, Fanny Pack, Hot Pack.  

STORYLINE: Nobody can get out of a ooey, gooey, huey mess like Yo Ram-blo. Tasked with all of the world's "ultra secret operational overseas death rescue missions with panache" Ram'blo seems to always "get 'er done" and usually comes out with only a few scratches on his arms (from crashing through cypress trees). An international bubblegum champion extraordinaire, Ram-blo recently and secretively SAVED THE ENTIRE FREAKIN' UNIVERSE by assuming Kernel Troutman's identity (with beret), locating the secret Russian micro-film, and destroying an entire village's goldfish pond in the process; hurling 374 RPG blasts, 112 knife slashes and 8 packs of bubblegum. "Well, yo," said Ram-blo after the mission.
